title: BloomSky Cloud Cover Jump Before Rain
dataSources: Weather-station observations (`ecowitt:obs`, `weatherflow:obs`), air-quality readings (`purpleair:aqi`, `airgradient:sensor`), soil-moisture/greenhouse sensors, aquarium controllers (`aquarium:sensor`).
app: Personal weather stations (Ecowitt/Ambient/Davis/WeatherFlow), air-quality sensors (PurpleAir/AirGradient), and aquarium/greenhouse/soil sensors via HEC and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=bloomsky:sky
streamstats window=3 avg(cloud_cover_pct) as prior
where cloud_cover_pct>prior+30
description: Detects BloomSky cloud-cover jumps preceding rainfall.
value: Surfacing bloomsky cloud cover jump before rain helps you act before small issues become habits.
implementation: Ingest the relevant weather, environment & garden export into `index=personal` and schedule this search weekly.
visualization: Table or chart of key fields.
grandmaExplanation: It shows when bloomsky cloud cover jump before rain matters for your routine.
